notes: This minor release raises the engine requirement to Bifrost 0.15.3 or later and depends exactly on bifrost.public.packs 0.14.0. Migration: Bifrost 0.15.2 and earlier reject the whole catalog because the restored Cargo SSH policy declares an empty required_capabilities list ("incomplete inventory metadata"); upgrade the engine or stay on rules 0.15.0. Bifrost 0.15.3 accepts an empty list (bifrost-dev#10941). Every locked policy identity verifies unchanged on the released Bifrost 0.15.3. Restored in bifrost.security 3.2.0 (#387): the opt-in bifrost.security.rust.cargo-ssh-git-host-key-unverified (CVE-2022-46176), held out since rules 0.13.0. It reports a locked git+ssh Cargo dependency in a package whose rust-toolchain file pins a Rust release before 1.66.1. Changed behavior: Bifrost 0.15.3 no longer reports a workspace .cargo/config.toml as unsupported dependency evidence, so the policy reads the workspace-root .cargo/config.toml configuration fact net.git-fetch-with-cli; the boolean true suppresses the finding for a pinned Rust 1.39.0 or later (the first Cargo that reads .cargo/config.toml) unless a .cargo/config.toml in a subdirectory sets it to anything else, where Bifrost 0.15.1 left the run inconclusive. Limitations: only workspace .cargo/config.toml files are read; ambient Cargo configuration, the legacy extensionless .cargo/config, CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI, rustup overrides and git insteadOf rewrites are not, and the extensionless file or the environment variable can make a suppressed project use the built-in fetcher again; an unpinned toolchain or a missing Cargo.lock leaves the run inconclusive. New opt-in policy in bifrost.security 3.2.0 (#284): bifrost.security.ruby.network-input-to-net-imap-host (CVE-2026-42245) reports a Net::HTTP.get response body that chooses the host of Net::IMAP.new on net-imap before 0.4.24, 0.5.0 to 0.5.13 or 0.6.0 to 0.6.3. Limitation: it needs the source-only bifrost.ruby.net-imap 0.2.0 model, which is not in bifrost.public.packs 0.14.0, so with the released packs alone the run is inconclusive (partial_discovery), never clean; a project can supply the model under .bifrost/semantic-models. net-imap 0.6.4 and 0.6.4.1, an unlocked net-imap and a double-splat call stay inconclusive. Known engine regression: on Bifrost 0.15.3, four or more sinks fed by one source in one method make a run inconclusive while the findings stay definite (bifrost-dev#14210); the network-input-to-net-imap-raw-arguments fixtures show it. New opt-in Node core taint policies in bifrost.security 3.2.0 (#393), each from a process.argv keyed read: bifrost.security.javascript.process-input-to-fs-path (fs.readFileSync, readdirSync, existsSync, statSync, lstatSync, accessSync, unlinkSync and rmSync paths, and as possible findings the callback readFile, readdir and unlink and fs/promises readFile, readdir, unlink and rm; CWE-22), bifrost.security.javascript.process-input-to-child-process-command (child_process.execSync(command); CWE-78) and bifrost.security.javascript.process-input-to-vm-code (vm.runInNewContext, vm.runInThisContext and new vm.Script code; CWE-94; evaluated code can escape its context, so the vm pack has no summaries, every finding is possible and the run inconclusive). The command policy works with the released bifrost.public.packs 0.14.0 models. Limitation: the fs policy needs the source-only, review-required bifrost.node-fs-javascript-declarations 0.2.0 and -summaries 0.3.0, and the vm policy the source-only bifrost.node-vm-javascript-declarations 0.1.0 pack, which are not in bifrost.public.packs 0.14.0; without them those runs are inconclusive, never clean. Not covered: open redirects through http.ServerResponse headers, exec, execFile, spawn and their shell: true forms, and execSync with options; a tainted value that reaches one of these and is not used afterwards gives no finding. Changed in bifrost.python-codeql-quality 0.1.2 (#383, bifrost-dev#11358): bifrost.python-codeql-quality.missing-docstring no longer reports test code (pytest-collected modules, unittest.TestCase subclasses, test* functions in modules that import pytest or nose) or a function a module's __main__ block calls; it reads the test_scope and entry_point fields that Bifrost 0.15.3 first emits (bifrost-dev#11705), withholds an undecided row rather than reporting it clean, and departs from CodeQL parity on purpose. All other policies, IDs and required capabilities are unchanged from rules 0.15.0. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
